text:
maria: Quick heads-up — AtlasGPU just updated the WAVE2 ETA. 40 units moved from 05/12 -> 05/19 due to staging QC. Impacting EU and APAC pool allocations.

devin: Ugh. Which SKUs? any H200 vs H100 split?

maria: 28 x A800, 12 x A100S. No H100s in this wave. Staging flagged 6 units with bent heatsinks -> RMA workflow.

juan: Can we pull from the fast-refurb pool to keep capacity steady? We have 16 refurb A800s at FRA depot.

sasha: FRA refurb are tagged as "temp-loan" — legal says we need an LOA for cross-customer loans. That takes 24h.

supply: Re: pricing — AtlasGPU offered a one-time expedite credit of $2,000 per unit if we accept cross-dock refurbs. Worth it to avoid Dedicated capacity penalties?

ryan: Quick math: penalty on reserved capacity SLA for missing throughput is ~ $6k/day for worst-case. If expedite credit avoids 3+ days outage for priority queues it's probably a net positive.

maria: Note: cluster-health shows increased queue on eu-west-1-gpu0, latency bump ~ 35ms p99 on generation endpoints. If we don't backfill, customer risk increases.

devin: Can ops-bot gate lower-priority jobs to reclaim capacity until loaners arrive?

ops-bot: @devin gates applied to queue "spot-training"; expected reclaim ~14 GPUs within 15m. :white_check_mark: 

juan: Good. Meanwhile logistics — what's the RMA plan for the 6 failed units? We need AWB + customs paperwork for EU return.

logistics: Working with AtlasGPU. They propose a cross-dock RMA: Atlas picks failed units, ships replacements from their DE pool. AWB draft: ATG-EX123456789DE. Customs code they're using is 847130 (computing machinery), but we'll double-check HS classification to avoid hold.

sasha: If replacements come from DE, we avoid extra tariffs, but need supplier invoice note for temporary export. Also ask them to mark as "unit exchange - no commercial value" to expedite customs.

maria: One more wrinkle: serials on the staging report don't match our manifest for 3 units (prefix mismatch). Could be swapped labels at depot. If we accept refurbs, we need serial traceability on handover.

devin: Can we accept with escrowed serials? i.e., mark capacity as "loaner" and run a background serial reconciliation job. If mismatch persists after 72h, swap back and invoice credit.

logistics: That process works but needs a paper trail. I'll draft an SLA addendum and an RMA acceptance form for signatures.

ryan: Ops: what's the cost of running reconciliation automation vs manual?

devin: Automation is ~$400 infra one-off + human audit if exceptions >10%. Manual triage estimated 6-8h of engineering time. Prefer automation.

maria: Decision: Proceed with FRA refurbs as temporary loaners to backfill EU capacity. Supply to finalize LOA and expedite credit acceptance. Atlas to send AWB & RMA manifest tonight.

juan: I'll hold 12 units in our reserve pool for APAC re-routing if needed.

logistics: Received AWB draft, shipping ETA 05/17 09:00 CET, airwaybill ATG-EX123456789DE. Requesting Atlas to add batch photos and serial scans.

sasha: Add clause: if label/serial mismatch >3 units, Atlas covers courier re-collect and customs penalty.

maria: Noted. @supply can you confirm expedite credit and sign LOA by EOD?

supply: On it. Negotiated credit bumped to $2,500/unit for any unit that causes >24h reclaim. LOA in progress.

devin: After we have loaners in, I'll patch autoscaler to prefer loaner pool for non-prod routes and keep production pinned to committed pool until serials clear.

ops-bot: Autoscaler change queued: prefer_pool=loaner-temp, TTL=7d. Apply? 

maria: Apply. Also add alert if loaner pool usage >60% for >2h.

ops-bot: Alert rule added.

juan: One ask for Atlas: require photo of heatsink + fan staging evidence for returned units so we can speed QA on reintroducing to refurb pipeline.

logistics: I'll include that in the RMA checklist. Atlas confirmed photos will be attached to AWB.

maria: I'll follow up with customers who might see slower completions. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

supply: LOA signed and sent at 3298765475. Atlas confirmed AWB finalized at 3298765488.

devin: Loaners scheduled to land 05/17 09:00 CET — autoscaler change live. Monitoring p99.

maria: Last_message: monitoring green on latency after 45m, queue back to normal. Close loop after serial reconciliation completes (72h).
